protocol.name: blur
protocol.description: The interfaces KWin (KDE Plasma's compositor) offers for blurring what is behind a surface, as defined in plasma-wayland-protocols' blur.xml (LGPL-2.1-or-later) — restated here with just what a client needs to generate its bindings: the interface names, versions and requests, in their protocol order. Integration::WindowGlass uses it.

interface.name: org_kde_kwin_blur
interface.description: set_region, then commit; takes effect with the surface's next commit. A null region blurs behind the whole surface.
